tasks.short: Determine optical element specifications from prescriptions and existing eyewear

steps.what: Examine prescriptions, work orders and existing eyeglasses, checking measurements and resolving unclear source details
Determine lens or optical element specifications, confirming ambiguities before recording the production requirement

tasks.design: Retain source examination and specification determination with the technician, using controlled records in {DOCS}. Missing or conflicting prescription and eyewear information goes for clarification; no system infers a replacement prescription or releases an unresolved production requirement.
tasks.previous_blocker: The sources can combine handwritten values, physical measurements and conflicting or damaged eyewear.
tasks.enabler_now: The supplied production digest does not establish reliable optical prescription interpretation or physical measurement replacement.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing intended prescription values from old, damaged or unsuitable eyewear characteristics.
tasks.human_edge: The technician can compare the physical item with the source order and recognise when clarification is necessary.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in interpretation time or authority to alter a prescription.

reach.task: Explain the exact source discrepancy needing clarification

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: optical specification determination requires checking prescription sources and physical eyewear; the digest does not demonstrate a labour saving for this task.

assumptions: Boundary is the technician's examination and determination of a production requirement, excluding prescribing, source measurements by other professionals and subsequent lens manufacture.

In s1 and s2 the technician checks job identity, eye or element identity, source revision, prescription values and units, relevant dimensions, physical measurements and conflicting details. Their capture and verification time is fully counted; no free structured prescription or suitable-for-production flag is assumed.

When clarification is needed, s2 includes the technician's request and checking of any later response before the specification is released. The originating professional produces that response only after the request; their unchanged work receives no saving.
Use existing native records and measurement tools. No additional extraction or rule system is proposed, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Actual prescription formats and frequency of conflicting sources
Who can resolve and authorise prescription changes
research_questions: Is there separately measurable duplicate data entry after the technician completes interpretation and measurement checks?

already_counted.description: Examine sources, resolve uncertainties and determine the production specification

approvals.approved_version: Exact optical production specification, prescription and order references, measurements and resolved clarifications before release; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross0 and net0 with zero upkeep. A clear repeat prescription and a damaged-eyewear discrepancy both retain full interpretation, measurement and clarification time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select optical blanks, molds, tools and grinding equipment

steps.what: Select and physically check lens blanks, molds, tools and wheels against production specifications
outputs: selected and checked optical materials and tooling

tasks.design: Keep material and tooling selection and physical checking with the technician, using the production specification in {DOCS}. Existing native stock or tooling references may support selection, but no automated choice or physical handling replacement is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Nominal identifiers alone do not establish the condition and suitability of the actual item.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest's general machining tools do not demonstrate optical blank, mold or wheel selection for this work.
tasks.still_hard: Matching the specification to available materials and detecting damage, wear or incompatible tooling.
tasks.human_edge: The technician can inspect the actual blank and tool before production begins.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in physical selection time or authority to substitute materials.

reach.task: Explain material or tooling mismatches before processing
reach.learn: Approved substitutions and equipment compatibility limits

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: physical optical material and tooling selection requires specification and condition checks; no optical selection saving is evidenced in the supplied digest.

assumptions: Boundary is selection and checking of actual materials and tooling, excluding specification determination, procurement and grinding or polishing operation.

The technician checks job reference, material, dimensions, optical blank type, tool or wheel identifier, equipment compatibility and observed condition during s1. All lookup, capture and physical checking time remains counted.
No free structured wear, suitability or available-stock flag is assumed. Missing identifiers, damaged items or uncertain substitutions require manual inspection and supervisor clarification.
Existing native inventory and tooling references come first. No new tool, rule mapping or integration is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: The actual proportion of selection time spent on physical checks
research_questions: Does selection contain a repeatable lookup burden separate from essential material and tool inspection?

already_counted.description: Select, handle and verify the actual optical materials and tooling

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross0 and net0 with zero upkeep. Routine blank selection and a worn-tool substitution question retain full lookup, judgement and physical checking time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep optical interpretation, physical measurement and material selection fully counted until a distinct repeatable burden is measured.
reach: Alert production supervisors to material and tooling mismatches
role.ambitious_version: An ophthalmic laboratory technician who gives production an unambiguous, checked requirement and selects actual materials with their condition and limits understood.
